properties.name: cachedb.sql.provider
properties.description: Selects the SQL provider. AUTO accepts exactly one provider starter; multiple providers require an explicit choice.

properties.name: cachedb.admin.http-enabled
properties.description: Publishes the same-port operations console only when cachedb-spring-boot-starter-admin is also present.

properties.name: cachedb.registration.source
properties.description: JDBC registers generated bindings with durable-source loaders; METADATA_ONLY registers Redis-only bindings.

properties.name: cachedb.scheduled-warm.enabled
properties.description: Enables declarative scheduled warm registration. Redis leases prevent the same warm definition from running concurrently in multiple pods.

properties.name: cachedb.sql.oracle.query-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Applies a finite JDBC statement timeout to Oracle write-behind operations. Valid range: 1-300 seconds.

properties.name: cachedb.sql.oracle.transaction-isolation
properties.description: Selects READ_COMMITTED or SERIALIZABLE for Oracle write-behind transactions.

properties.name: cachedb.sql.oracle.duplicate-race-retries
properties.description: Bounds retries for concurrent first-insert ORA-00001 races after durable version inspection. Valid range: 0-10.

properties.name: cachedb.sql.oracle.empty-string-policy
properties.description: Controls Oracle empty-string handling. REJECT prevents silent conversion to NULL; NORMALIZE_TO_NULL must be an explicit domain decision.

values.description: Use the only provider starter found on the classpath.
Fail before SQL execution when a Java String is empty.
Bind an empty Java String as SQL NULL explicitly.
